paragraphs.en: Jack Pumpkinhead was surprised by His Majesty the Scarecrow, who wore faded blue clothes and a crown heavy with jewels. The crown made his painted face look thoughtful, but otherwise he appeared simple and flimsy.
paragraphs.zh: 杰克南瓜头被这位国王稻草人惊到了，稻草人穿着褪色的蓝色衣服，戴着一顶镶嵌着宝石的王冠。这顶沉重的王冠让他的涂鸦般的脸显得深思熟虑，但除此之外，他看起来简单而脆弱。

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow King's first impression was that Jack might be mocking him, but after closer inspection, he realized Jack’s smile was carved into his pumpkin head.
paragraphs.zh: scarecrowking初见jack时以为他在嘲笑自己，但仔细一看才发现，jack的笑容是雕刻在他南瓜般脸庞上的。

paragraphs.en: "Where did you come from?" the Scarecrow asked in wonder. "And how are you alive?"
paragraphs.zh: “你从哪里来的？”稻草人惊奇地问道，“你怎么还活着？”

paragraphs.en: Jack explained he came from the Gillikins and spoke a foreign language.
paragraphs.zh: 杰克解释说他来自吉利kins王国，并且讲着一种外国语言。

paragraphs.en: "Oh, I see!" the Scarecrow exclaimed. "I speak Munchkin and Emerald City tongues, but perhaps you speak Pumpkinhead."
paragraphs.zh: “哦，我明白了！”稻草人脱口而出，“我会说 munchkin 和Emerald City 的语言，但也许你会说南瓜头的语言。”

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow said, "Exactly so, your Majesty." He continued, "So it will be impossible for us to understand one another."
paragraphs.zh: scarecrow 回答道：“正是如此，陛下。”他继续说道：“这样一来，我们恐怕永远无法相互理解了。”

paragraphs.en: "That is unfortunate," replied the Scarecrow thoughtfully. "We must have an interpreter."
paragraphs.zh: “真是遗憾，”稻草人沉思着回答，“我们必须得找个翻译。”

paragraphs.en: "What is an interpreter?" asked Jack.
paragraphs.zh: “什么叫译员？”杰克问道。

paragraphs.en: "Someone who understands both my language and yours," explained the Scarecrow. "When I speak, the interpreter tells you what I mean; when you speak, he translates for me."
paragraphs.zh: “能通晓我们两种语言的人，”稻草人解释说，“当我说话时，翻译会告诉你我的意思；而当你说话时，他会帮我翻译。”

paragraphs.en: "That sounds simple enough," said Jack, pleased with this solution.
paragraphs.zh: “这听起来简单 enough ，”杰克满意地说。

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow then commanded the Soldier with Green Whiskers to find someone who could interpret between the Gillikins and the Emerald City. The soldier left on his mission.
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人随后命令留着绿色胡须的士兵去寻找一个能够充当格利吉亚人和翡翠城之间翻译的人。士兵随即出发执行任务。

paragraphs.en: "Shall we sit?" asked the Scarecrow.
paragraphs.zh: “我们坐下来吧？”稻草人问道。

paragraphs.en: "I cannot understand you," replied the Pumpkinhead. "If you want me to sit, make a sign."
paragraphs.zh: “我听不懂你的意思，”南瓜头回答，“如果你想让我坐下，就打个手势吧。”

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow rolled an armchair behind the Pumpkinhead and pushed Jack awkwardly onto the cushions, causing him to twist like a jackknife.
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人把一把扶手椅推到南瓜头身后，勉强将杰克推到垫子上，只见他身子一扭，像是一把折断的弹簧。

paragraphs.en: "Did you understand that sign?" asked the Scarecrow politely.
paragraphs.zh: “你明白那块牌子的意思吗？”稻草人礼貌地问道。

paragraphs.en: "Perfectly," declared Jack, adjusting his position.
paragraphs.zh: “完美！”杰克调整了一下姿势，脱口而出。

paragraphs.en: "Not more so than your Majesty," replied Jack frankly.
paragraphs.zh: “比起您陛下来说也不遑多让。”杰克坦率地回答道。

paragraphs.en: "There is this difference between us," said the Scarecrow. "I bend but do not break; you break but do not bend."
paragraphs.zh: “我们之间有个区别，”稻草人说道，“我弯曲但不会折断；你折断了却不会弯曲。”

paragraphs.en: At that moment, a soldier returned with a young girl named Jellia Jamb. She was sweet and modest, with green eyes and hair, wearing a dainty green skirt and green satin slippers adorned with lettuce.
paragraphs.zh: 就在那时，一名士兵带着一个名叫杰莉亚·詹姆的年轻女孩回来了。她温婉谦逊，碧绿的眼眸和头发映衬着她的清新脱俗，身着一件精致的绿色短裙，脚上穿着绣有生菜图案的绿色丝鞋。

paragraphs.en: "Why, it's little Jellia Jamb!" exclaimed the Scarecrow as she bowed before him. "Do you understand the language of the Gillikins, my dear?"
paragraphs.zh: “啊，原来是小杰利亚·詹姆！”稻草人一边鞠躬一边惊叫道，“你懂吉利kins人的语言吗，我的亲爱的？”

paragraphs.en: "Yes, your Majesty," she answered, born in the North Country.
paragraphs.zh: “是的，陛下的 scarecrow，”她回答道，出生在北方王国。

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow proposed Jellia as an interpreter between himself and the Pumpkinhead. "You will translate his words to me, and mine to him," he said.
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人提议让杰莉亚担任他和南瓜头之间的翻译，“你将把南瓜头的话翻译给我，我把自己的话翻译给他。”他说。

paragraphs.en: "Very satisfactory," replied Jellia.
paragraphs.zh: “非常令人满意,”杰莉亚回答道。

paragraphs.en: "Start with why you're here," instructed the Scarecrow, turning to Jellia.
paragraphs.zh: “先说说你来这里的原因吧，”稻草人指导着，转向杰莉亚。

paragraphs.en: Instead, Jellia addressed Jack: "You are truly a remarkable creature. Who created you?"
paragraphs.zh: 相反，杰莉亚转向杰克问道：“你真是一个非凡的存在。是谁创造了你？”

paragraphs.en: Jack answered, "A boy named Tip."
paragraphs.zh: 杰克回答道：“一个名叫蒂普的男孩。”

paragraphs.en: "What did he say?" asked the Scarecrow, puzzled.
paragraphs.zh: “他说了什么？”稻草人疑惑地问道。

paragraphs.en: "He said your Majesty's brains seem loose," Jellia demurely replied.
paragraphs.zh: 他说陛下的心思似乎有些散乱，杰莉亚轻声说道。

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow shifted uneasily and touched his head. "It’s fortunate to understand two languages," he sighed.
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人不安地挪了挪位置，摸了摸脑袋。“能懂两种语言确实幸运。”他叹了口气。

paragraphs.en: "Ask him if he minds being jailed for insulting me," suggested the Scarecrow.
paragraphs.zh: “让他回答是否介意因侮辱我而入狱,”稻草人建议道。

paragraphs.en: "I didn't insult you!" Jack protested indignantly.
paragraphs.zh: “我没有侮辱你！”杰克愤慨地喊道。

paragraphs.en: "Tut-tut, wait until Jellia translates my words," cautioned the Scarecrow.
paragraphs.zh: “得啦，得啦，等杰莉亚把我的话翻译完再说,”稻草人警告道。

paragraphs.en: "All right, I'll wait," replied Jack grumpily but smiling. "Translate, young woman."
paragraphs.zh: “好吧，我等等。”杰克闷声回答，脸上却带着微笑。“你来翻译，年轻 lady。”

paragraphs.en: "His Majesty asks if you're hungry," said Jellia.
paragraphs.zh: 杰莉亚说道：“陛下的陛下询问您是否饿了。”

paragraphs.en: "Oh, not at all!" Jack responded more pleasantly. "For it's impossible for me to eat."
paragraphs.zh: “哦，根本不是那么回事！”杰克回答得更加和气一些，“因为我根本无法进食。”

paragraphs.en: "The same goes for me," remarked the Scarecrow. "What did he say, Jellia?"
paragraphs.zh: “我也是同样的感受，”稻草人说道，“他到底说了什么，杰莉亚？”

paragraphs.en: "He asked if you noticed one eye is bigger than the other," she replied mischievously.
paragraphs.zh: 她调皮地回答道：“他问你注意到一只眼睛比另一只大一些没有。”

paragraphs.en: "Don't believe her, your Majesty," Jack cried.
paragraphs.zh: “不要相信她，陛下,”杰克喊道。

paragraphs.en: "Oh, I don’t," answered the Scarecrow calmly. He then looked sharply at Jellia and asked: "Are you sure you understand both Gillikin and Munchkin languages?"
paragraphs.zh: “不，我没有。”稻草人冷静地回答道。随后他锐利地望向杰莉亚，问道：“你确定既懂吉利亚语又懂芒奇金语吗？”

paragraphs.en: "Quite certain, your Majesty," Jellia said, trying not to laugh.
paragraphs.zh: “陛下，我确信无疑，”杰莉亚说道，努力忍住不笑。

paragraphs.en: "But why do I seem to understand them myself?" inquired the Scarecrow.
paragraphs.zh: “但我为什么似乎也能理解他们呢？”稻草人自问。

paragraphs.en: "Because they are one language!" declared Jellia, now laughing. "Your Majesty didn't know that only one language is spoken throughout Oz?"
paragraphs.zh: “因为它们是一种语言！”杰莉亚笑道，“陛下的意思是，在奥兹国只使用一种语言？”

paragraphs.en: "Is it really so?" the relieved Scarecrow exclaimed. "Then I could have been my own interpreter!"
paragraphs.zh: “果真如此吗？”那位松了口气的稻草人脱口而出，“那我就可以自己当翻译了！”

paragraphs.en: "It was all my fault, your Majesty," Jack admitted, looking foolish.
paragraphs.zh: “这一切都是我的错，陛下。”杰克承认道，显得有些尴尬。

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow warned Jack, "Thinking wisely is essential. If not, you might as well remain a dummy—like you are."
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人警告杰克：“明智地思考至关重要。否则，你干脆就呆在这里像你现在这样吧。”

paragraphs.en: "Indeed!" agreed the Pumpkinhead.
paragraphs.zh: “果然！”南瓜头附和道。

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow softened his tone: "Your creator wasted good pie dough on you, making an indifferent man out of it."
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人软化了语气：“你的创造者本可以用那块好面团做出一个出色的人，却把它做成了一个平庸之辈。”

paragraphs.en: Jack replied, "I didn't ask for this, Your Majesty."
paragraphs.zh: 杰克回答说：“我可没有求过这种事，陛下。”

paragraphs.en: The King added, "Neither did I. Let's be friends since we're different from ordinary people."
paragraphs.zh: 国王接着说：“我也一样。既然我们与常人不同，那就让我们成为朋友吧。”

paragraphs.en: "Of course!" Jack exclaimed.
paragraphs.zh: “当然！”杰克脱口而出。

paragraphs.en: Surprised, the Scarecrow asked, "Do you have a heart?"
paragraphs.zh: 惊讶之下，稻草人问道：“你有一颗心吗？”

paragraphs.en: "No; just an imaginative figure of speech," Jack explained.
paragraphs.zh: “不，只是一个富有想象力的比喻而已。”杰克解释道。

paragraphs.en: "Not having brains, you shouldn't imagine so freely," warned the Scarecrow.
paragraphs.zh: “没有智慧，你就不应该这样随意想象,”稻草人警告道。

paragraphs.en: Jack responded without understanding: "To be sure!"
paragraphs.zh: 杰克不明白其中含义，脱口而出：“当然！”

paragraphs.en: His Majesty dismissed Jellia Jamb and the Soldier with Green Whiskers. Then he led Jack into the courtyard to play a game of quoits.
paragraphs.zh: 他的 Majesty 陛下 驳回了 葛丽亚·詹姆 和 绿胡须士兵 的请求，然后带着 杰克 进入庭院，玩起了 投环游戏。
